title: Ordinary scalar extension of small etale module sheaves
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $A,B$ commutative rings, and $\varphi:A\to B$ a ring homomorphism. On sheaves of modules on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], define $E_{\varphi,T}:\operatorname{Sh}(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)\to\operatorname{Sh}(T_{\mathrm{et}},B)$ by postcomposing with $B\otimes_A-$ and sheafifying [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Its specified scalar adjunction $E_{\varphi,T}\dashv\operatorname{Res}_{\varphi,T}$ is induced by the ordinary module extension/restriction adjunction and sheafification. These are the existing functor etaleSheafExtendScalars and adjunction etaleSheafExtendScalarsAdjunction; no flatness, boundedness, or finite-coefficient assumption is imposed.
